name: junos-mcp
description: MCP server for junos-ops, giving Claude Code access to Juniper JUNOS devices: show commands, config diffs and pushes, firmware upgrades, RSI/SCF diagnostics, and a daily_brief health check across a fleet. All destructive tools default to dry-run, and push_config uses commit-confirmed with an automatic post-commit rollback. Requires a junos-ops config.ini (device inventory plus SSH/NETCONF credentials) on the machine running the server -- this plugin can only pass through the file's path, so you must author config.ini yourself before any tool is usable.
